Who is IRONSCALES?
We are IRONSCALES. We are passionate about cybersecurity. We care about people. We care about our Scalers, customers, and partners. Our team acts with intentionality and our actions are always in the best interest of our teams, our customers, and our company. Our culture is focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and the drive to push boundaries and take everything to the next level.
We are the Scalers

Our Fearless Team of Experts: At IRONSCALES, our Scalers are a team of dedicated individuals. Proudly wearing this title as a badge of honor, we are driven to take on the biggest challenges and never back down.

Whether it's making our customers safer or crushing the competition, we are up for the task–no matter how daunting it may seem. Working together as a cohesive unit, we strive to pave the way towards a more secure future.

Living #TheScalerWay

Living the scaler way means weaving our core values into the fabric of our everyday lives. These 5 key principles guide us forward as we strive for a connected community of Scalers and a Safer tomorrow for our customers and partners.

Supportive

We foster a Culture of Collaboration. Our team is committed to mutual success. We value collaboration in tackling challenges, and we work together to overcome them.

Ambitious

We are driven by a relentless work ethic and have a strong sense of pride. This value underscores our commitment to continually raising the bar and celebrating our collective triumphs with enthusiasm.

Focused

We are dedicated to our goals, navigating decisions with intention and the best interests of our people, our customers, and our company at heart.

Excellent

Excellence is a mindset. We set high standards, believe in surpassing limits, and fully commit to hitting our goals. Our curiosity and learning never stops.

Resourceful

We embrace proactive and creative problem-solving. We believe in taking initiative, finding effective solutions, and being agile.

Benefits & Perks of Being a Scaler

Competitive Health and Wellness Benefits

We are proud to offer a comprehensive suite of competitive health and wellness benefits designed to cater to your physical and mental well-being.

Flexible Time Off 

We understand that a healthy work-life balance is paramount for maintaining not only productivity but also happiness and well-being. That's why  offer Flexible Time Off, a program designed to empower our team members with the freedom to take the time they need, when they need it.

Hybrid Work Schedule 

We provide a Hybrid Work Schedule, a flexible work arrangement designed to blend the best of both worlds – the structure and camaraderie of in-office work with the convenience and comfort of working from home.

Our Hiring Philosophy

It is our mission to create a smooth and positive candidate experience. Our hiring philosophy encompasses four key principles:

Culture & Individuality

Bringing a fresh cultural perspective, individuals who join our team contribute significantly to the diversity and vibrancy of our group dynamics. They don't just fit in; they stand out by adding new dimensions to our already dynamic team. 

A Passion for Building

At the heart of our mission lies a profound passion for building a safer tomorrow. It's more than just a goal; it's a commitment that drives every aspect of our work.

Innovation & Creativity

An innovative and creative mindset is the cornerstone of progress and success in both personal and professional life. It’s about seeing the world through a lens of possibility and potential, where challenges transform into opportunities and ideas flourish into breakthroughs.

Relevant Work/Life Experience
